breaking_changes: Express 4.9.5 to 5.2.1 may affect route matching, middleware/error handling, static serving behavior, and transitive body-parser/send interactions.
MongoDB driver ^2.0.0 to 7.3.0 is a major callback/API/result-shape migration around MongoClient.connect, collection.insert/update, and aggregation.
Winston ^1.0.1 to 3.19.0 changes logger construction; current code uses new winston.Logger and custom Logstash transport monkey patches.
Socket.IO client 1.1.0 to 4.8.3 is protocol-sensitive and may not communicate with an old server endpoint.
Nodemailer 1.4.0 to 9.0.1 changes supported Node/runtime expectations and transport behavior.
Sharp ^0.14.1 to 0.35.2 is a native dependency upgrade and may change install/runtime requirements and callback behavior.
uuid 2.0.1 to 14.0.1 likely affects CommonJS import style and uuid.v4 usage.
request is deprecated; latest npm metadata reports 2.88.2 with deprecation notice.
gc-stats is deprecated; latest npm metadata reports 1.4.1 with deprecation notice.
Vendored static browser libraries under tv-radio-frontend/static/libs are outside npm lock/manifest control and include old named versions.
risk_summary.notes: Primary language is JavaScript on Node.js using npm package manifests only; no package-lock/yarn/pnpm lockfile was found. Build/test scripts are not declared in tv-radio-frontend/package.json. The user validation command is `node app.js` from tv-radio-frontend. Existing uncommitted changes include tv-radio-frontend/package.json and untracked repo metadata files; analysis did not revert or overwrite them.

coverage_notes: GitNexus index for repo `tv-radio` was available and used for repository/process context, but it returned file/symbol context without line ranges for these file-level dependency hits. Exact line ranges in this report therefore come from targeted `rg -n` searches and manifest reads. tv-radio-admin/** was excluded from affected-file findings and no admin code was executed, per inputs. Admin package manifests were not required to determine the frontend validation impact. npm latest/deprecation metadata was queried only for tv-radio-frontend dependencies.
